slides.headline: The questions owners ask us before they hire us
“Is this legal?”
slides.body: Yes. We work within each platform's own policies and reporting process. No hacking, no insiders, no fake accounts.

slides.headline: “Do I pay if it doesn't come down?”
slides.body: No. You pay once it's gone.

slides.headline: “What do I need to do?”
slides.body: Send the link and sign the agreement. Our specialists handle the rest.

slides.headline: “How long does it take?”
slides.body: The platform sets the pace, not us. We keep watching until it's resolved and tell you the outcome.

slides.headline: “Is it confidential?”
slides.body: Yes. We never name clients, and we only share a case with written consent.

slides.headline: “What does it cost?”
slides.body: One fixed fee per review, agreed in writing before we start. No retainer.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
